claims.claim: **Discoid lupus (DLE) is a chronic, scarring skin disease and the commonest cutaneous lupus.** Long-lasting scaly plaques, mainly on the face, scalp and ears, can leave scars, atrophy, pigment change and permanent hair loss.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **It mostly affects women in their 20s to 40s** and is rare in children. It is commoner in skin of colour; New Zealand data show a markedly higher relative risk for Māori and Pacific peoples than for people of European descent.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **UV light can provoke DLE,** though lesions also occur on covered skin. Smoking is commoner in people with DLE and makes antimalarials work less well.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **DLE is localised above the neck in 80% and generalised in 20%.** Early red patches become plaques with adherent scale and follicular plugs (the 'carpet-tack' sign when scale is lifted), with favourite sites being the nose, cheeks, ear lobes and the conchal bowl of the ear.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Some develop SLE:** about 5% with localised DLE and 15% with generalised DLE.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Examine fully for other signs of lupus,** and confirm with a skin biopsy in most cases.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Baseline tests:** full blood count, renal function, ANA (often negative) and urinalysis.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Differentials include** lichen planus, actinic keratosis, polymorphic light eruption, drug-induced and chilblain lupus, squamous cell carcinoma, sarcoidosis and lupus vulgaris.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Protect from the sun all year, with clothing plus generous high-SPF broad-spectrum sunscreen;** sunscreen on its own is not enough. Some people need to avoid window glass indoors or fit UV-blocking film.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Recommend vitamin D supplements for people who strictly avoid the sun, and help them stop smoking.**
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **First treatment for localised DLE: intermittent courses of potent or ultrapotent topical corticosteroid for several weeks.** Intralesional corticosteroid injection is sometimes used.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Topical calcineurin inhibitors** (tacrolimus ointment, pimecrolimus cream) are an alternative.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Camouflage make-up and wigs** help confidence when scarring is extensive.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Oral prednisone or prednisolone** can give short-term control.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Longer-term systemic options, alone or combined,** include hydroxychloroquine, chloroquine, mepacrine, methotrexate, acitretin or isotretinoin, mycophenolate, dapsone, thalidomide and biologics (belimumab, rituximab), among others.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **DLE is chronic and can last for years; treatment is often difficult.** ⚠️ Squamous cell carcinoma can rarely develop in a long-standing plaque on skin or mucosa.
claims.locator: DermNet (Alani Z, Jarrett P; previous contributor Oakley A), New Zealand, 'Discoid lupus erythematosus', 2022, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/discoid-lupus-erythematosus, retrieved 2026-09-23
